hooks.name: Sim sanity check
hooks.description: Compile-check every simulator so syntax errors surface immediately. Run manually after editing sims.

action.command: python -c "import glob,py_compile,sys; fs=glob.glob('**/*_sim.py',recursive=True); [py_compile.compile(f,doraise=True) for f in fs]; print('OK: '+str(len(fs))+' sim files compiled')"
